record.text: Which projects use the wave-like motion of atoms as the measuring element in high-precision sensors of gravity and acceleration?
record.reference_answer: Six projects use atom (matter-wave) interferometry as the measuring element for precision gravity and acceleration measurement, spanning instrument building, sensitivity theory and commercial translation. MWGRAV pursued matter-wave gravitation sensors at SYRTE, noting that atom interferometers already compete with or beat inertial sensors built on other technologies, and targeting gravimetry, gradiometry, metrology and gravitational-wave detection. Dommigs designed a monolithic reflective interferometer with diffraction slabs cut into a silicon monolith, evaluated for prospecting gravimetry and for accelerometers for long-distance under-water navigation. TICTOCGRAV combined ultracold Cadmium and Strontium optical clocks with Bragg interferometers, aiming at tests of the weak equivalence principle below 10^-13, while MEGANTE probed the gravitational field with cold atoms in free fall to redetermine the gravitational constant G beyond torsion-balance and pendulum accuracy. On the enhancement and translation side, QBAS investigated theoretically how entanglement between atoms and photons could raise atom-interferometer sensitivity, pointing at gravity gradiometers for detecting mineral reserves, and SEQ funded an engineer at M Squared Lasers to develop a first-iteration magneto-optical trap into a stable atom interferometer and commercialise a gravimeter.

record.text: Which projects are aimed specifically at preventing, or detecting at an early stage, the skin and tissue damage that long periods of unrelieved pressure inflict on bedridden or wheelchair-bound patients?
record.reference_answer: Six H2020 grants in this corpus are aimed at this problem, and most are sensing-plus-prevention systems rather than treatments. i-LiveRest (696939) and its successor grant LiveRest (830134) put impedance, pressure, temperature and humidity textile sensors on a wheelchair or mattress to score Tissue Viability in real time and then trigger the prevention strategy that suits the user and context; their target group is Spinal Cord Injury patients, 85% of whom develop such an injury. Qone (735302) does the equivalent for bedridden patients with a pressure-relieving mattress carrying temperature and pressure mapping sensors feeding a personalised risk-score algorithm, claiming roughly a 75% reduction in new cases. The two JUMPAIR grants (709595, 783594) build a smart anti-decubitus mattress system that remotely tracks known ulcer-activity biomarkers to raise early alerts to the hospital. STINTS (811965) is the research and training strand: it studies the biomechanical and biochemical pathways by which prolonged pressure and shear destroy skin integrity, in order to improve preventative aids such as mattresses and insoles, early-stage diagnosis through non-invasive biomarkers and sensors, and ultrasound therapy.

record.text: Which projects have the development or production of bacteriophages as an antibacterial product or treatment among their stated objectives, where the phages are applied to kill bacteria in human patients, livestock, crops or food rather than in environmental settings such as wastewater, and where the phage work is not merely an investigative strand under some other objective?
record.reference_answer: Eight projects set out to make bacteriophages themselves into an antibacterial product. For patients: PhagoPROD scales up the GMP manufacturing and GLP diagnostics behind Pherecydes Pharma's personalised phage therapy against antibiotic-resistant infections; PHARMS screens phages of resistant Acinetobacter baumannii, Helicobacter pylori and Haemophilus influenzae and engineers phage vectors into a battery of phage-based therapies; and CURE builds phage preparations as candidates for clinical testing in asthma, using phages to rebalance a dysbiotic airway microbiome. For animals and food: AVANT tests veterinary medicinal products containing bacteriophages and polymers against enterotoxigenic E. coli diarrhoea in weaning pigs, PHAGOVET develops a biocide plus two food-additive products based on selected bacteriophages to control Salmonella and E. coli in poultry production, and AntiCamp develops a spray of phage-based particles that inject antibacterial genes into Campylobacter jejuni for food decontamination. For crops: PhageFire develops a phage-cocktail biopesticide against fire blight (Erwinia amylovora) in pome fruit, and VIROPLANT reports accomplishing initial steps to bring to the European market the first phage cocktail for a crop disease. What unites them is that producing the phage is the objective and the phage is the product; they are a small applied minority among the corpus's many phage projects, most of which instead study phage biology, phage-host coevolution or bacterial anti-phage defence systems.

record.text: Which projects are developing chips or other dedicated hardware in which artificial neurons compute by firing brief pulses at each other, the way nerve cells do?
record.reference_answer: A cluster of H2020 projects builds computing hardware in which the signals are neuron-like pulses rather than clocked digital arithmetic. NeuRAM3 proposed to fabricate a chip implementing a neuromorphic architecture supporting spike-based learning, in FDSOI at 28nm design rules with RRAM synapses; MeM-Scales works on analog spiking microprocessors whose memory devices cover timescales spanning up to 9 orders of magnitude; SYNCH couples the brain of a living animal to a silicon neural network of spiking neurons on a chip through neuromorphic synapses; ULPEC connects a neuromorphic event-based camera to a Spiking Neural Network with memristive synapses; ChipAI builds resonant-tunnelling nanophotonic sources and detectors that fire and detect neuron-like light-spiking signals at >10 GHz per spike rates; NEPSpiNN puts event-based spiking processing of surface EMG into a compact ultra-low power neuromorphic chip; BeFerroSynaptic packaged TEXEL, a 9mm x 9mm neuromorphic chip carrying 180 adaptive-exponential integrate and fire (AdExp-I&F) neurons fed by ferroelectric synaptic devices; and TEMPO and ANDANTE develop the underlying technology and hardware platforms (integrate-and-fire engines, emerging memories, 3D integration, edge SNN chips). The same set also includes NANOINFER, whose intelligent memory chips combine digital CMOS logic with spiking neurons circuits, Fun-COMP, whose nanoelectronic and nanophotonic building blocks implement spiking neural networks in hardware, NeuroAgents, which fabricated the DYNAP-SE2 mixed-signal Spiking Neuronal Network processor for neuromorphic robotic agents, and SOFT, which designed, fabricated and tested a magnetic domain-wall spiking neuron and used a magnetic neural network to recognise patterns from human voice converted into spikes.

The CRITIC INDEPENDENTLY TESTED this load-bearing class rejection at round 1 with its own regex families (artificial neuron|silicon neuron|neuron-like|photonic neuron|pulse-based comput|pulsed neural|action potential|excitable laser): 35 hits, all read at context, every one a synaptic/memristive device (NEURAMORPH, RESWITCH, RESCUE, PROJESTOR, COFFEE), an oscillator machine (RadioSpin, SpinAge) or biological. Class-D rejection HELD.

Critic's round-2 own-wording run ("integrated circuit built from silicon neurons that communicate with short voltage bursts instead of clocked binary arithmetic") found no new satisfying project, and confirmed that the newly added gold member 871737 IS retrievable by a paraphrase at dense rank 15 even though it missed the drafter's own k=20 pool.
why_good: The question discriminates on a boundary no single term draws: 'spiking neural network' appears in 9 objectives, the theme in 17, and the neighbouring word 'neuromorphic' in 135 texts, so keying on any one term either misses most of the set or pulls in memristor-material and in-memory-computing projects that do not compute with spikes. It fills the engineering / electrical-electronic-engineering bucket at vector L3 with a paraphrase item - the bucket the corpus profile calls thin for paraphrase - and it needs report text as well as objectives, since two gold members (SOFT, BeFerroSynaptic) name no spiking hardware in their title or objective at all. findings.claim: 871737 BeFerroSynaptic satisfies the notes' own gold criterion - it fabricated and packaged physical chips whose neurons are integrate-and-fire spiking neurons - yet the notes reject it as carrying no spike-based computation.
findings.evidence: get_project_text(871737). Report summary: 'Unlike the conventional vonNeumann architecture, that uses digital numbers for calculation, in our spiking neural networks the information is represented by event driven and correlated voltage spikes.' workPerformed: 'The 2BeFerro chip implements a Calcium-based learning rule by utilizing 64 Exp-I&F neurons with one learning synapse each. Additionally, our high-complexity demonstrator TEXEL is a 9mm x 9mm neuromorphic chip ... features 180 adaptive-exponential integrate and fire (AdExp-I&F) neurons ... TEXEL chips have been packaged and functionality was verified.' A class-B member the notes list as READ, but whose recorded reason is factually wrong about the text.
findings.fix_direction: ADVISORY - add 871737 to gold and to pooling_evidence.accepted, and name the TEXEL chip in the reference answer.
findings.ruling_why: The executed read quotes a fabricated, packaged TEXEL chip with 180 AdExp-I&F neurons and a report stating information is carried by voltage spikes, which meets the notes' own positive criterion, and the recorded rejection reason is refuted by that same stored text. RESOLVED at the fix round; the critic has no residual claim.

findings.claim: 747848 ProbSenS is IN on evidence identical in kind to the evidence that puts 707373 ECogNeT OUT - algorithms converted to the spiking domain and run on someone else's neuromorphic substrate.
findings.evidence: get_project_text(747848). Objective: 'a novel low-power event-driven probabilistic Very Large-Scale Integration (VLSI) architecture ... bioinspired Generative Deep Neural Network (GDNN) models' - no spike, no neuron firing. workPerformed: 'determined conversion and learning rules to run the algorithms in the spiking domain on a programmable neuromorphic substrate ... trained offline with regular real-valued ReLU activations ... converted to the spiking domain by using the open source SNN toolbox'. The substrate is not stated to be its own fabrication anywhere in the stored text. The drafter had itself flagged ProbSenS as its weakest gold member.
findings.fix_direction: ADVISORY - drop 747848 under criterion (c) alongside ECogNeT and STRoNA and strike its reference clause.
findings.ruling_why: Its own deliverable in the quoted text is event-driven probabilistic VLSI sensor readout, with the spiking network arriving as a converted ReLU CNN run on a substrate never shown to be its own fabrication, which is exactly criterion (c) used to exclude ECogNeT and STRoNA, so the criterion was not being applied evenly. RESOLVED at the fix round.

findings.claim: 899598 PHEMTRONICS names an 'all-optical spiking neuron circuit' among its own target devices and is silently excluded with no reason recorded.
findings.evidence: get_project_text(899598). Report summary lists among the device classes it is developing: 'all-optical spiking neuron circuit, with integrated all-optical synapses, capable of the prototypical artificial intelligence.' Against that, workPerformed and finalResults report only switches, modulators, photodetectors, an RF switch and materials work - the same shape as the recorded SHADOKS exclusion. The exclusion is defensible; the absence of a recorded reason is the defect.
findings.fix_direction: ADVISORY - add 899598 to the OUT list with the SHADOKS-style reason.
findings.ruling_why: The exclusion is substantively defensible on the SHADOKS ground, but the notes record no reason for it at all, so the gold set does not survive independent re-derivation at that boundary; since the notes were already being reopened, this was a zero-marginal-cost repair rather than a note to ride. RESOLVED at the fix round.

findings.claim: 713736 NeuroPsense fabricated and sold DYNAP chips - the same chip family that gold member 724295's own text calls a Spiking Neuronal Network processor - and is excluded only because its own text stops at 'asynchronous event-based'.

This is the first generally available demonstrator of ultra-low power neuromorphic processor chips, fabricated using mixed-signal (analog plus digital) technology ... several units have now been sold'. The DYNAP-SE2 is a mixed-signal Spiking Neuronal Network (SNN) Processor' - the successor of the very chip NeuroPsense produced. findings.claim: The fix round's arithmetic is honest and reproduces.

The only residue is the field name - pooled_candidate_count covers 6 items that were not in the k=20 pool, a convention the notes disclose.

findings.claim: The drafter's stated cause for the bad class-B triage matches what the critic found independently.
findings.evidence: Both round-1 hits, 871737 and 899598, had their decisive sentence in a report field, and 871737's was in the summary that the drafter's own regexp context window would have shown had it been read. The drafter's words: it triaged that group from titles and objective snippets rather than from the report passages that put those projects in the group.

judge_decisions.rationale: The question measures whether a system can find, from paraphrased wording, the projects that build hardware where computation is carried by neuron spikes - and two of the thirteen labels currently misreport that. BeFerroSynaptic is a packaged integrate-and-fire chip scored as a miss, so a condition that retrieves it would be punished for being right; ProbSenS is scored as a hit on the same ground the notes use to exclude ECogNeT and STRoNA, so the criterion is not one criterion. Both are bounded label edits that leave the question, the wording, the paraphrase style and the L3 cell untouched, which is a fix and not a redesign.

The round-1 fix took and the critic has no residual claim on any of the three targets: the false BeFerroSynaptic reason is corrected from the text, ProbSenS sits under a criterion (c) now written as one sentence that covers named and unnamed external substrates alike, and PHEMTRONICS carries a reason a reader can reproduce. What was actually wrong in round 1 was a triage done from titles and objectives instead of the report passages that put those projects in the group; the drafter named that cause and re-read the whole class-B group against it, which is why three further loose reasons were found and rewritten rather than left to be discovered later. The remaining NeuroPsense question is a single documented boundary call, not a broken label. The within-candidate stop rule does not fire: the class re-appears at MID as a judgement call, not as the same defect surviving its fix, and a RECORDED finding never counts toward it.
